title: Ubud vs Canggu: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Ubud for culture and authentic Bali; Canggu for surf, digital nomad life, and beach clubs. Do both — they're just 1.5 hours apart.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Ubud $35–65/day; Canggu $50–100/day. Ubud's jungle villas and local warungs are cheaper; Canggu's café brunch culture adds up fast.

categories.name: Beaches & Surfing
categories.summary: Canggu has Batu Bolong and Echo Beach surf breaks. Ubud is inland with no beach access.

categories.name: Culture & Temples
categories.summary: Ubud wins by a wide margin — Sacred Monkey Forest, Tirta Empul, Tegallalang Rice Terraces, and 10+ major temples. Canggu has limited cultural access.

categories.name: Digital Nomad Life
categories.summary: Canggu has Dojo (best coworking), highest café density, strongest nomad community. Ubud has Hubud and is better for focused solo work.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Ubud wins for local warungs and organic cafés. Canggu wins for brunch culture, specialty coffee, and international variety.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Canggu has beach clubs (Old Man's, The Lawn), bars until 4am. Ubud has live music and cultural performances but goes quiet by midnight.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Ubud is Bali's best day-trip hub — Mount Batur, Nusa Penida, waterfalls, east Bali temples all accessible from one base.

categories.name: Climate
categories.summary: Ubud runs 2–4°C cooler (26°C vs 30°C) due to higher elevation — more comfortable for walking, temples, and working.

faq.question: Should I stay in Ubud or Canggu for my first trip to Bali?
faq.answer: Start with Ubud for culture and temples, then move to Canggu for surf and beach clubs. Most travelers do 3–4 nights each. They're 1.5 hours apart.

faq.question: Is Ubud or Canggu cheaper?
faq.answer: Ubud — jungle villas $25–70/night, warung meals $1.25–$2.50. Canggu villas run $50–120/night and the brunch/café scene inflates daily spend to $50–100.

faq.question: Is Ubud or Canggu better for digital nomads?
faq.answer: Canggu wins for community and coworking (Dojo); Ubud wins for focus and lower cost (Hubud).
